name: Azure OpenAI Service / Azure AI Foundry inference
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, representative model GPT-4.1-2025-04-14 Global standard deployment, observed 2026-10-14 ($2.00 in / $0.50 cached / $8.00 out; Data Zone $2.20/$0.55/$8.80; Regional $2.20/$0.55/$8.80). GPT-4.1-mini Global $0.40/$1.60, nano $0.10/$0.40. Three deployment SKUs change the price on the same model: Global, Data Zone (EU or US), Regional (up to 27 regions). Batch API = 50% of Global Standard. Provisioned throughput (PTU) is reserved-capacity pricing, not token-priced. Azure AI Foundry also hosts third-party models (Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI) each with its own catalog price.
notes: The OpenAI-on-Azure path: GPT-4.1's 1,048,576-token context is the biggest published context in this record set. Three deployment types (Global / Data Zone / Regional) are a data-residency choice that shows up directly in the per-1M price - Global is cheapest, Regional pins inference inside one of 27 regions. Artificial Analysis benchmarks Azure on Llama 3.3 70B; no measured row was extracted for this pass so the latency fields stay null. Foundry's model catalog (Meta, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral) prices per model on the same page and is the 'other models' clause in the basis.
